exercises.title: Requirements risks 1 — which stage does the risk belong to?
exercises.problemHtml:
Wiegers groups requirements risks by stage: elicitation (vision and scope, time spent, customer involvement, innovative products, nonfunctional requirements, solutions presented as needs…), analysis (prioritisation, technically difficult features, unfamiliar technologies), specification (understanding, time pressure to proceed with TBDs, ambiguous terminology, design in requirements), validation (unvalidated requirements, inspection proficiency) and management (changing requirements, change process, unimplemented requirements, expanding scope).

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Rủi ro yêu cầu theo giai đoạn.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

exercises.title: Requirements risks 3 — write risk statements
exercises.problemHtml:
Write RISK_LIST: three requirements risks for ClinicCare, each { id, statement, stage, mitigation }. The statement must be in condition–consequence form ("If …, then …"); stage one of elicitation, analysis, specification, validation, management; the three risks must cover three different stages; each mitigation is a concrete action (at least 6 words).

Requirements

  • Ids unique, like RK-1.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Viết ba rủi ro yêu cầu cho ClinicCare dạng "If …, then …", ba giai đoạn khác nhau, mỗi rủi ro có biện pháp cụ thể.

Yêu cầu

  • Id không trùng, dạng RK-1.

examplesJson.output: { id: 'RK-1', statement: 'If pharmacists are not interviewed, then the e-prescription flow may miss dispensing rules.', stage: 'elicitation', mitigation: 'Schedule an interview and an observation session with the pharmacist in week 2.' }

hintsJson: Biện pháp có người, việc, thời điểm.

exercises.title: Requirements risks 4 — risk is your friend
exercises.problemHtml:
Facing risks openly is healthy: the sooner a risk is identified, the cheaper it is to control. Collaborative elicitation with extensive user involvement can cut requirements creep nearly in half.

Each question is graded on its own; the explanation appears after you submit.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
